newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh mob attacks suspected child abductors.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh mob attacks suspected child abductors.

text.p: Three people died after being assaulted by an angry mob in the Bangladesh capital Dhaka on Wednesday, on suspicions they were child abductors, police and witnesses said.
A young man in the crowd died of bullet wounds in hospital after police fired on the mob in an attempt to rescue the suspects.
Police had also used teargas and batons, witnesses said. The mob set ablaze a police van and fought with the police, injuring at least six officers, they said.
Witnesses said local people at Dhaka's downtown Badda area had caught the three suspects in front of a school and assaulted them after becoming suspicious of their movements.
The three later died of their injuries and their bodies were taken to the morgue at Dhaka Medical College Hospital, police and witnesses said.
Wednesday's violence was the latest in the series of recent mob attacks on suspected child abductors.

The Home (interior) Ministry last week warned of stern action against such violence, but police said on Wednesday that few people appeared to be taking the warning seriously. Police said the violence followed a series of kidnappings of young children. "Some victims managed to flee from the abductors and gave harrowing accounts to their parents," one police officer said.
He said police had had little success so far in trying to arrest the alleged abductors.
